author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
Using AI to interrogate philosophical questions concerning AI.

What if AI writes better Sci-Fi than humans, can it win the Sci-Fi awards?

Many literature awards ban AI, people seems OK with that, but it would be an irony banning AI from Sci-Fi awards. This idea could be a Sci-Fi story of itself.

shared_article.title: The Robot May Write About Us, but It Cannot Win
